svg.title: Modern SIS — Full System Architecture
svg.desc: Layered system architecture showing the four tiers: client layer, SIS core, integration lanes, and AI governance layer connecting to Moodle

g.text: Browser / responsive web app — React 18 + TypeScript + Vite
Python (Django 5 + DRF) — REST API — JWT auth — RBAC
Lane B — LTI v1.3 tool provider
SIS data + Moodle engagement ETL → Qdrant RAG store + analytics-ready projections
Central gateway · rate limits · content filters · audit log · human review queue · NIST AI RMF
OpenAI-compatible gateway · retrieval-augmented generation · Docker-based Linux deployment
Existing platform — content delivery, assessment, collaboration — not modified at core level
